name: Jean Haner
reason: Too thin: her own site (jeanhaner.com) offers no classes or sessions of her own any more; its Events page lists only three on-demand Shift Network courses (counting once), its Sessions page sends people to certified practitioners, and her energy-clearing workshop site (clearhomeclearheart.com) now points to another teacher, Melanie Mattison. No YouTube channel is linked, and her books could not be confirmed because Open Library refused our connections during this run; her newest book is also sold on releasing stress and clearing anxiety (health rule). She has a published email (contact@jeanhaner.com) and her site names The Shift Network, so a re-run could work if Open Library answers and her books are enough.
